title: 10 Best Viscum Album Preparations

Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for their potent therapeutic effects. Teas and decoctions are popular for their soothing properties and ease of preparation. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized dosage option for modern users. Syrups are commonly used for their palatable form and are especially beneficial for children or those with swallowing difficulties.
